Amara Diallo | Backend Engineer | NexCart Technologies  
Building scalable, high-performance systems that power e-commerce growth.  

Architected and optimized REST APIs that handle millions of requests daily, driving seamless integration between microservices. Leveraged Go to design fault-tolerant services, reducing latency by 30% in production.  
Automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, cutting deployment time by half and improving reliability. Dockerized critical components, enabling rapid scaling across AWS environments.  
Designed PostgreSQL schemas for high-traffic databases, ensuring sub-100ms query performance during peak loads. Implemented monitoring with Prometheus and alerting systems to proactively resolve issues before they impact users.  
Migrated infrastructure to Terraform, standardizing environments and reducing manual setup time by 40%. Used Python for data pipeline automation, streamlining analytics workflows.  
Continuous innovator in cloud-native solutions—turning complexity into competitive advantage. Let’s build smarter systems together.
